ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Suspicious Registry File Imported Via Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the import of '.reg' files from suspicious paths using the 'reg.exe' utility

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ import\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%temp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%tmp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%appdata\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*")))
